summary: tellyo-colours declares unpinned POC-named runtime dependency unrelated to its purpose
details: tellyo-colours is advertised as a CSS/SCSS color palette and ships an inert palette as its own code. Its package.json declares a runtime dependency on `abbishal-poc-as-dependency` with the wildcard range `*`, with no integrity constraint. The dependency's name self-labels it as a proof-of-concept and bears no relation to a color palette. On `npm install`, the registry resolves whatever version is currently published under that name and installs it alongside tellyo-colours, running any lifecycle scripts the resolved package declares. Because the version is unpinned and no integrity hash is specified, the executed content is whatever the current owner of that name chooses to publish at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
